lines.t: My promise is standing. My holy covenant endures forever.
Therefore, when one comes to me in the name of the Son, in sincerity and in truth they are forgiven.
For I said, let there be a lamb without spot or blemish,
sacrificed for the atonement of sin.
And let the lamb be the Son of God,
In whom all the nations of the earth shall be blessed
And so it is forever and ever
